title: Secret of the Mimic: Rewired
description: SOTM: Rewired adds functionality, mobs, and systems from the game "Five Night's at Freddy's: Secret of the Mimic" Original game by Steel Wool Studios
body:
NOTE: THIS IS AN EXTREMELY EARLY BETA AND NOT THE FINAL VERSION.

Secret of the Mimic: Rewired adds mobs, systems, and decor inspired by Five Nights at Freddy’s: Secret of the Mimic. **(This project is NOT officially affiliated with Steel Wool Studios. It is a fan‑made mod based on the original game.)**

 
Current Content
- The Data Diver
  
- Upgrade Stations
  
- Mailboxes
  
- Security Doors
  
- M2 (The Mimic)
  
- Digityper
  
- The Mannequin
  
- M2‑related decor (Unfinished M2, Deactivated M2)
  
- Power Lever
  
- Big Red Button
  
- Various building blocks
  
 
Planned Features
- Storage Tube System
  
- Terminals
  
- Custom GUI
  
- Functional Mannequins (sound‑based alerts)
  
- White Tiger Plush
  
- All Mascot Suits (wearable by M2)
  
- M2 voice‑mimicking for Survival Mode
  
- And More
  
 
Included Functional Systems
- Fully functional Data Diver
  
- Working mail system allowing players to send mail to each other
  
- Data Diver Upgrade Station (upgrade minigame coming soon)
  
- M2 can break down security doors during a chase
  
- Buttons and levers can be linked to iron doors using the Bundle of Wires
  
- Permissions for Upgrade Stations and Security Doors can be configured with the Bundle of Wires
  
 
Known Issues
- (Please report any additional bugs you encounter!)
  
- Inverted pivot points on certain mobs and blocks
  
- Some blocks have broken or missing textures
  
- Certain Data Diver permissions may not correctly interact with security doors
  
Coding by 0703fuga

Models, texures, and animations by vancetheGAMER

 

If you have any questions, or you would like to report a bug, join our discord server here!: [Discord](https://discord.gg/nPtUj38h3f)
